acceptance_criteria.statement: The API exposes continuity status DTOs from an injected ContinuityStatusReader without synthesizing placeholder status data.
The API fails closed when the continuity status store is not injected instead of returning fake empty production data.
The frontend continuity page loads the API response and renders service cards with mode badges, worker roles, run progress, failure reason, and empty/error states.
Navigation exposes the continuity page to operators.
